full_judgment:
Fazle Munim J. - The petitioner has been carrying on the business of stationary cum-Pan shop in the space under the stair case of the second building of Nawab Yusuf D.I.T. Market, Dacca since 1965. Excepting the verbal permission of the officer of respondent No. 1 he had no other right there. No order of allotment was over made in his favor. Since the year 1968 he has been applying for the settlement of this space under the stair case. He received no reply from the respondent No.1. On 7.8.72 the petitioner again filed an application for allotment of the space to him. He also applied to the Chairman D. I. T. on 19. 12. 72 and a copy of his application has been annexed to this petition and marked as Annexure 'A'. Finally, on 12.3.74 the petitioner filed an application for allotment of the space and this time he managed to get the recommendation of the 4 Trustees of the D. I. T. namely, (1) Mr. Gazi Golam Mostafa, M.P. and President, Dacca City Awami League, (2) Mr. Md. Hossain alias Kala Mia, (3) Mr. Ashequr Rahman, Administrator, Dacca Municipality, (4) Mr. Fazlul Karim, Trustees, D. I. T. But the petitioner was, however, surprised to get the impugned notice on 16. 4. 74. This notice, as contained in Annexure 'C' to this petition, is as follows: 

 The stair case of 2nd building ground floor, Nawab Yusuf Market; Dacca has been allotted to Mrs. Rehana Begum, 13. Shamsabad Lane, Dacca on 27. 3. 73 for its conversion into a shop room. The said allottee has deposited security money of Tk. 639/00 (equivalent to one years rent) and first estimated amount of Tk. 5624/00 and thereafter revised estimated amount of Tk. 1394/- but due to security of cement construction work has not yet been taken into hand by DIT.
